evidence_scope: Only feedback_v2_q3 and feedback_v2_q4 are treated as true hybrid evidence.

q3_true_hybrid_best.note: Reliable mixed-source best before/through current Q3 Round10 monitoring; still above target because N10 is slow.

q4_pre_round11_best.note: Too slow and not accepted as final; used as a safety baseline for interpreting Round11.

q4_round11_first_screen.note: First dynamic-route screen only; not accepted.

round11_q4_changes: Stopped using a fixed initial ring as the default route; bootstrap now dynamically selects the next probe from current posterior risk and travel cost.
Kept ring and none modes in the search space as controls, but adaptive is the default anchor.
First joint probe, second joint probe, and tail probe target the unknown channel with highest posterior survival risk instead of unknown[0].
Added searchable gates for first probe, post-clear scan, bootstrap mode, bootstrap travel penalty, and bootstrap radius.
Reduced dynamic posterior-probe particle count from 200000 to 80000, and tail particles to 24000, to improve search throughput without changing virtual-time scoring.

round11_status.latest_observation: Generation 0 emitted first SCREEN rows; no Round11 VALID metric has been emitted yet at this snapshot.

validation_policy: Fixed repeated validation is used only for model selection, not as a formal independent holdout test.
